_comment: Sword readability. THE GAMEPLAY CAMERA IS THE JUDGED FRAME. A previous round passed every showcase angle and failed a fresh critic outright, who identified the one gameplay-camera frame unaided and said of it: 'I cannot find a weapon. Not a pixel of blade.' The three good frames were good because they were shot from angles no player will ever occupy. So the gameplay shots come first here and they are the ones that count: they omit camera_pitch_deg and camera_distance entirely, which capture.gd resolves to player.tscn's own spring arm, and the player faces away as they always do without input. gp_idle is the control — every other gp_ frame must be unmistakably distinguishable from it. Showcase angles follow, kept only for reading pose detail. Shot at (16, -2) rather than the spawn, which is ringed with logs and signs that every swing frame overlapped. capture_at counts physics frames after warmup; the attack registers on frame 2, so clip frame k lands near k + 3.

shots._note: CONTROL. Identical camera to every other gp_ shot, no input at all.
shots.name: gp_idle

shots._note: slash_a wind-up, clip frame ~2: blade vertical above the shoulder, tip measured at y 2.26 against a 1.98 m head.
shots.name: gp_slash_a_windup

shots._note: slash_a live, clip frame ~6: blade 1.5 m out on the right flank, ribbon spanning the descent from above the head.
shots.name: gp_slash_a_live

shots._note: slash_a live, clip frame ~9: blade crossing the front, so the arc is carried by the ribbon rather than the blade.
shots.name: gp_slash_a_live_late

shots._note: slash_a recovery, clip frame ~17: hitbox long closed, blade back up on the follow-through, ribbon still on screen. If the arc is gone by here it was never persistent enough to read.
shots.name: gp_slash_a_recover

shots._note: slash_b live, chained follow-up. Timed from capture.gd's state readout rather than arithmetic — at 32 the clip really is slash_b at t=0.117 with the hitbox live. Clip frame ~7: rising, blade above the head, the opposite screen direction to slash_a.

shots.name: gp_slash_b_live_late

shots._note: Charge tell: attack held past the 1067 ms threshold. Blade and its glow go saturated cyan — the swing owns orange, so the two can never be confused.
